title: Pre-Operative Laboratory Pricing Methodology — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Managed Care Contracting bulletin.** When a post-payment denial of outpatient surgery on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) is refunded, the laboratory codes 85025, 80048 and 85610 under revenue code 0300 keep the value set by the laboratory schedule method, each code read by its billed units as well as its charges from the charge postings of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing). The method follows the claim's payer class and the campus of the hospital account:

| Payer class and campus | Value of each of the three codes |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim, services at Riverbend Surgery & Imaging Center - Grand Chute | its billed units times its clinical laboratory fee schedule amount times 1.25 |
| Commercial HMO Claim, services at a hospital campus (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton or Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah) | the lesser of that schedule value (billed units times schedule amount times 1.25) and its charges |
| any other claim | the payer class's expected allowed percentage of their charges |

**Clinical laboratory fee schedule amounts**
| Code | Schedule amount per unit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 85025 | 7.77 |
| 80048 | 8.46 |
| 85610 | 4.29 |

The three codes together are never valued above their billed charges.

**Worked example (hypothetical inputs).** A Commercial HMO Claim for services at Appleton bills 3 units of 80048 charged 60.00 and 1 unit of 85025 charged 5.00. Schedule values: 3 times 8.46 times 1.25 is 31.725, below its 60.00 charges, so 31.725; 7.77 times 1.25 is 9.7125, above its 5.00 charges, so 5.00; the two codes together 36.725.

**Points of judgement**
- A Commercial PPO Claim for services at Appleton is "any other claim" for this method; so is a Commercial HMO Claim at Grand Chute.
- Under the Commercial HMO tier each code is compared with its own charges separately.
